title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
author: J. K. Rowling
summary: Few people believe Harry's account of the events of the previous year, and the ministry sends an overbearing official to take control of Hogwarts. Harry and his friends start a secret group to learn the defensive magic nobody will teach them.
readIf: you want a long, angry, politically sharp book about not being believed and about organizing to resist.
skipIf: you want the lighter tone of the early books, as this is the longest and bleakest of the first five.

pairings.reason: The next book, which shifts to backstory and a quieter dread.
Another story where young people fight a corrupt authority and pay a heavy price.
A shorter, more reflective take on a young person who sees through a controlling system.
